thread:
Mike: ran a 6h soak in staging with the multi-tenant mix. seeing persistent 429s for org=acme even though usage < committed quota. burst regen looks stuck for that org. attaching sample logs.
Anya: can you paste the load generator command + rate profile? also which tenant routing policy did you use? :thinking_face:
Mike: here's the runner args:
```
./loadgen --profile multi-tenant.json --duration 6h --clients 500 --key-distribution skewed
```
Key distribution: 70% small tenants, 25% mid, 5% large (acme spikes). We used routing policy `prefer-local` and token-bucket with burst=1000, refill=100/s.
Devon: thanks. TL;DR: sounds like burst token refill not accounted per-org when we do per-key sharding. I saw a recent deploy to rl-service that changed how refill ticks are aggregated. logging?
Mike: logs (trimmed):
```
[rl-service] 2026-03-18T09:12:01Z INFO org=acme key=k-123 allowed=false reason=burst_exhausted balance=0
[rl-service] 2026-03-18T09:12:01Z DEBUG shard=5 tick_delta_ms=0
```
Lucas: that `tick_delta_ms=0` is suspect. we had a race where GC paused the refill aggregator loop while shards thought ticks progressed. leads to zero refill for a window. i filed a quick fix in PR #4123 but needs e2e.
Kelly: our console dashboards don't currently surface tick_delta or per-shard refill metrics. that's why oncall missed it during the soak. can we add a telemetry counter and make an alert for avg_tick_delta > 50ms?
Maya: +1 on alert. also we should expose per-org burst_balance on the model route dashboard (top panel). ops needs quick visibility.
sre-bot: Incident created -> STG-RL-429-ACME-20260318 by Mike. Severity: low. Link: https://redwood/incident/STG-RL-429-ACME-20260318
Devon: proposed plan: 1) revert rl-service change to aggregator (hotfix), 2) add tick_delta metric + alert, 3) re-run soak with deterministic seed and full key hashing (no skew). can someone volunteer for the revert? I'll draft the revert PR.
Lucas: i'll pair with devon on the revert and add a unit that simulates long GC pauses.
Kelly: i'll add the dashboard panels and wiring for per-org burst_balance and tick_delta. will also create a Grafana alert rule and a Console-level occupancy panel.
Mike: scheduling a re-run tomorrow 09:00 PT with new build + dashboard. also will add an endpoint to the loadgen to emit the exact per-key trace to S3: s3://redwood-staging/loadtraces/1825002468-acme.json
Anya: when we re-run, let's also sweep the routing policy test: prefer-local vs cost-based to see if routing changes amplify the effect.
Devon: small note: when running synthetic tests, use `--sticky-seed` so key hashing is stable across runs. otherwise shard-to-key mapping moves and changes where the bug surfaces.
Kelly: estimated ETA for dashboard + alert: 3h. revert ETA: 30m once PR is made. rerun ETA: tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Maya: adding to runbook: if tick_delta spike seen, enable fallback to per-key refill (slower but safe) and annotate incident.
Mike: thanks all. will ping when the hotfix is up. :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: deploybot: rl-service v2.14.1 hotfix deployed to staging by Lucas at 2026-03-18T10:03:12Z
Lucas: hotfix deployed, starting soak warmup now.
Mike: warmup looks good, no 429s in first 10m. continuing to soak.
Anya: monitoring dashboards.
Kelly: alert rule firing test OK.
Mike: +1, looks stable for now. closing incident after full 6h run completes; will post final summary.
